simplificationProposals.proposal: Separate development/test/pilot/production report views; production-target ancestry of Phase 2B needs an explicit policy decision.
simplificationProposals.authorityRequired: Release authority approves any change to existing gate scope.
simplificationProposals.coveragePreserved: Keep real production target, migration, backup and secret requirements for production; prove equivalent pilot controls on an approved pilot target.

simplificationProposals.proposal: Reuse one versioned evidence bundle across B04/B07/B08 and B09/B10.
simplificationProposals.authorityRequired: No approval needed for read-only aggregation; changing decision rules requires the existing policy owner.
simplificationProposals.coveragePreserved: Retain separate strength, ownership, rotation, revocation, operating and candidate checks.

simplificationProposals.proposal: Bootstrap native register from verified ownership/establishment instead of requiring an earlier register ID.
simplificationProposals.authorityRequired: Real owner adoption and establishment verification.
simplificationProposals.coveragePreserved: No simulator or agent approval; retain scoped appointments, signature evidence and revocation.

limitations: 95 gate-related package commands were cataloged, not all executed or certified. Direct script references and consumers are recorded; unresolved policy scope is explicit.
Historical intake counts are retained separately from current observed failures and never summed as independent vulnerabilities.
